race.comment: COSTA STAR (2) is the one to beat after a strong second at Junction over 1200m last week. She is racing well, and with a good record on this track, she gets her chance to go one better. DASHING DIVA (8) was beaten by 5 lengths into fourth at Junction but any horse can be forgiven for a bad run on that track for the first time. She can improve sharply and is a serious top 4 threat. MAGIC CARATS (1) showed plenty of ticker to win by a head 3 starts back and gets the right draw to bounce back. She must be respected. ADDICTIVE DREAM (3) was disappointing when ninth here last time but she gets top hoop Troy Turner in the saddle this time, and even from a wide gate, she can turn it around. Include in all top 4 combos. HOT NOVA (10) bounced back with a strong second at Junction and looks ready to build on that effort. She has to be included in the top 4 chances.
